_comment: Defaults for flag rules (SPEC §7). Every threshold and severity here is a clinical/grading choice for the instructor to confirm (SPEC §14). A scenario can override any rule's fields under settings.rules.<ruleId>.

tier-timeout._comment: Flags timeliness 'late'/'very late' orders. Thresholds and which orders count: rules.timeliness.

call-light-response._comment: Late → amber, very late → red. Thresholds: rules.timeliness.callLights.

alarm-response._comment: Late → amber, very late → red; alarms that clear on their own before 'late' are not flagged. Thresholds: rules.timeliness.alarms.

priority-mismatch._comment: A student's priority for a patient doesn't match the instructor's tag for longer than graceMin (after either changes). flagUnassigned: also flag patients a student never prioritized.

timeliness._comment: One source for 'how late is late' (engine/timeliness.js): the command center, debrief and the tier-timeout / call-light-response / alarm-response rules all read it. Minutes from active/due to done. Instructor to confirm (SPEC §14). Scenarios can override parts under settings.rules.timeliness.

groupStatus._comment: Command center: a group 'Needs attention' if any needsAttention count is reached, 'Falling behind' if any fallingBehind count is reached, else 'On track'. Counts include open items.

codeResponse._comment: Debrief response time for a code: first of these interventions charted after the code starts.

vitalsCompare._comment: Debrief display only: a charted manual vital 'differs' from the scripted value when off by more than this.
